name: Hunter Agent Of The Green
body:
Agents of the green are fiercely dedicated to the preservation of the natural world and are among a select few chosen by the Green Faith to deliver secret messages across the miles from one order to another. Masters of mobility, agents of the green specialize in getting from here to there, expertly utilizing terrain to their advantage.

They can foil their foes by altering the topography of the landscape, and can even siphon power from the earth itself, infusing their bodies with renewed vigor to ensure mission success.

An agent of the green has the following class features.

Transmutative Flexibility

In addition to spells gained by an agent of the green as he gains levels, each agent also automatically adds one bonus transmutation spell to his spells known each time he gains the ability to cast a new spell level. These bonus spells must be on the druid or ranger spell lists, and they do not count against the agent’s total allotment of known spells.

This alters spellcasting and replaces the summon nature’s ally spells gained by other hunters.

Unhampered (Ex)

At 1st level, an agent of the green gains a swim speed equal to his base land speed.

At 4th level, he gains a climb speed equal to 1/2 his base land speed.

This replaces nature training and wild empathy.

Agent Talents

As an agent of the green gains experience, he learns a number of talents that aid him and confound his foes.

Starting at 1st level, an agent of the green gains one agent talent. He gains an additional agent talent every odd numbered level thereafter. An agent of the green cannot select an individual talent more than once unless specified otherwise. Agent talents are treated as rogue talents for the purpose of qualifying for the Extra Rogue Talent feat.

This replaces animal companion, hunter tactics, improved empathic link, and all bonus tricks.

Eye for Anomalies (Ex)

Whenever an agent of the green with this talent is in a favored terrain and comes within 10 feet of a mechanical trap, he receives an immediate Perception skill check to notice the trap. (This check should be made in secret by the GM.) Furthermore, while in a favored terrain, an agent receives a bonus equal to his Wisdom modifier on all Reflex saves made to avoid or reduce damage from a mechanical trap, hazard or disaster.

Languages Across the Lands (Ex)

When an agent of the green selects this talent, he gains a number of bonus languages equal to his Wisdom modifier. He can gain additional languages at a later time if his Wisdom modifier increases.

Master of Motion (Ex)

An agent of the green can select any one of the following bonus feats: Acrobatic Steps, Dash, Nimble Moves, or Skill Focus (acrobatics, climb, or swim). He can select this talent more than once, each time selecting a different feat.

Modify Micro-Environment (Sp)

An agent of the green with this talent gains the ability to cast air bubble as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to his hunter level.

He can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every four agent of the green levels he possesses.

Rogue Talents (Ex)

An agent of the green can select any of the following rogue talents: expert leaper, fast stealth, green tongue, ledge walker, rogue crawl, rope master, stand up, strong stroke, or wall scramble. He can select this talent more than once, gaining a new rogue talent each time.

Superior Terrain Mastery (Ex)

An agent of the green with this talent increases all of his favored terrain bonuses to attack, initiative, and skill check rolls by +1.

Tireless (Ex)

As a swift action, once per day, an agent of the green with this talent can gain one extra move action in a round that can only be used to move. This talent can be taken more than once, but no more than one additional time per five hunter levels. Each additional time the talent is taken, the agent of the green gains an additional use per day.

Special

Since an agent of the green has no animal companion, he always applies the animal companion’s animal focus to himself instead, as if his animal companion was dead.

Terrain Specialist (Su)

At 2nd level, once per day, as a move action, an agent of the green can turn a 15-foot radius area into difficult terrain for a number of rounds equal to his Wisdom modifier. At 11th level, this increases to a 30-foot radius. The area of effect must fall within 60 feet of the agent.

Furthermore, an agent of the green is immune to the effects of any difficult terrain that he creates with his terrain specialist ability. At 4th level, all creatures considered to be allies of the agent share his immunity.

This replaces precise companion.

Favored Terrain (Ex)

At 3rd level, an agent of the green can select one terrain from the ranger’s favored terrains chart. While in this terrain, an agent gains a +1 dodge bonus to his armor class, and a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls, initiative checks, and Acrobatics, Climb, Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, Survival, and Swim skill checks.

At 8th level, and again at 13th and 18th level, an agent of the green may select an additional favored terrain. In addition, at each such interval, the circumstance bonuses on attack, initiative, and skill check rolls in any one favored terrain (including the one just selected, if so desired) increases by +1. (If a specific terrain falls into more than one category of favored terrain, the agent bonuses do not stack; he simply uses whichever bonus is higher.)

This replaces teamwork feats.

Gift of Renewal (Su)

Once per day, when an agent of the green is in one of his favored terrains and falls to 0 or fewer hit points (but is not yet dead), he can use an immediate action to gain a number of hit points equal to his hunter level + his Wisdom modifier.

At 16th level, the amount of hit points an agent receives from this ability is equal to twice his hunter level + his Wisdom modifier.

This replaces raise animal companion.

Greater Talents

At 11th level, and every other level thereafter, an agent of the green can choose one of the following greater talents in place of an agent talent.

Additional Favored Terrain (Ex)

An agent of the green with this talent can choose a bonus favored terrain which grants bonuses just as though he had received it through his terrain specialist ability.

Background Blend (Ex)

This talent allows an agent of the green to use the Stealth skill to hide in any of his favored terrains, even if the terrain doesn’t grant cover or concealment.

Far Strider (Sp)

This talent allows an agent of the green to cast dimension door once per day as a standard action with a caster level equal to his hunter level.

Magical Resources (Ex)

An agent of the green with this ability can cast two additional spells per day. These spells must be at least one level lower than the highest level agent of the green spell he can cast and must be from the transmutation school.

Share Talent (Ex)

Once per day, as a free action, an agent of the green with this talent can share his favored terrain bonuses with all allies within 60 feet of him for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 his agent’s level. This talent can be selected up to two times.

Surmount Hindrance (Su)

This talent allows an agent of the green to ignore impediments to his mobility. For a number of rounds per day equal to his hunter level, he can move normally regardless of natural or magical effects that impede movement, as if he was affected by freedom of movement. This effect occurs automatically as soon as it applies. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

This replaces speak with master, greater empathic link, and one with the wild.
